info.title: Agricultural Biotechnology Security Platform
info.description:
Agricultural Biotechnology Security Platform — precision farming protection, GMO traceability, and food supply chain security.

**Markings:** the permissioned ledger runs single-node ordering (DEMO/SIMULATION); its cryptography is real. All AI models are trained on synthetic data generated by this repository.

post.summary: Verify a stored record against its ledger anchor
post.description:
Recomputes the entity's content hash and compares it with the anchored value.
MISMATCH means the stored record was altered after it was anchored. Restricted to
the record's own organisation(s) or a cross-tenant oversight role (T-05/BOLA).
